notes: AI styles and difficulty levels. A style decides what the AI wants to do; a difficulty decides how well it does it. Neither grants extra resources or extra vision: every AI plays under the same fog, prices and command limits as a player.

doctrines.name: Balanced
doctrines.description: Scouts steadily, builds the cheapest fighting line and sends growing waves at the briefing's numbers.

doctrines.name: Rush / Swarm
doctrines.description: Spends everything at once on the cheapest units, sends small waves early and often, and searches with extra scouts.

doctrines.name: Turtle
doctrines.description: Keeps a standing home guard, defends a wide perimeter, and only commits large waves once it knows where the enemy is.

doctrines.name: Tech
doctrines.description: Fields a smaller army of its most capable units, flies recon often, and saves up rather than spending on cheap units.

difficulties.name: Easy
difficulties.description: Thinks every three seconds, takes eight seconds to react to a new contact, gives few orders at once and never pulls damaged units back.

difficulties.name: Normal
difficulties.description: Thinks every second and reacts at once.

difficulties.name: Hard
difficulties.description: Thinks twice a second, pulls damaged units back earlier and keeps its scouts moving faster.
